articles.title: Crypto's powerhouse super PAC suffers costly setback as Democrats sweep Congress
articles.snippet: The industry's primary campaign arm had cultivated a reputation as an unstoppable force, but more than a third of its spending failed to hit the mark, especially in Ohio.

articles.title: U.S. Democratic sweep could be the final nail in the ‘Clarity Act’s coffin’
articles.snippet: Industry experts warn the Clarity Act is likely dead in its current form as incoming Democratic majorities eye tighter scrutiny of crypto markets and tokenized stocks.

articles.title: Crypto Long & Short: ICE is betting on retail’s appetite for quick outcomes
articles.snippet: Retail traders increasingly want trades that resolve fast, from prediction markets to same-day options. Andy Baehr of GSR argues perpetual futures belong in that group, and that ICE’s deal to bring Trade[XYZ]’s Hyperliquid markets onshore is a play for that customer, one that doesn’t need a crypto asset to work.

articles.title: The election changes Washington. The work on crypto continues
articles.snippet: The next Congress inherits an unfinished assignment: establishing clear, lasting rules for digital assets that protect consumers and ensure American innovation continues to thrive, writes Blockchain Association's Lindsay Fraser.

articles.title: Global asset manager Schroders brings emerging market bond fund to Solana
articles.snippet: The global asset manager, which oversees $1.1 trillion in assets, is bringing an actively managed bond strategy onchain through tokenization specialist Centrifuge.
